name: Pyramid Semiconductor
old_description: Pyramid Semiconductor is a manufacturer of semiconductor Integrated Circuits including MIL-STD-1750A Processors, SRAMs, EEPROMs and FCT/FCT-T Logic.
about:
Pyramid Semiconductor is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. The company was formed in January 2003 when it acquired the product lines of Performance Semiconductor. In March 2021, HEICO Corporation's Electronic Technologies Group acquired Pyramid Semiconductor, and the business now operates as part of HEICO/3D PLUS USA in Silicon Valley.

Pyramid Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor manufacturer producing integrated circuits including MIL-STD-1750A processors, SRAMs, EEPROMs, FCT/FCT-T logic, and multi-chip modules. Wafers are fabricated at outside foundries (TSMC in Taiwan and LA Semiconductor in the USA), while the company's 10,000-square-foot Sunnyvale facility handles wafer testing, ceramic clean-room assembly, burn-in, environmental testing, electrical testing, marking, and quality assurance. The company supports over 100 Standard Military Drawings (SMDs) and offers custom logic functions and packaging with short lead times.

The company serves military, aerospace, industrial, and commercial markets. Its MIL-STD-1750A processors have been used by military customers for over two decades, and its QML-certified manufacturing line supports more than 100 SMDs for defense and aerospace programs. Industrial and commercial customers use its SRAMs, EEPROMs, and logic devices in embedded systems requiring high reliability and long-term supply.

Pyramid Semiconductor positions itself as a sole-source supplier committed to long-term availability of legacy MIL-STD-1750A products. It emphasizes a secure, independent supply chain with established foundry relationships and in-house assembly and test capabilities to ensure continued availability and short lead times for custom solutions.
